newsitem.title: USA: CME April hogs down sharply in late trade.
newsitem.headline: CME April hogs down sharply in late trade.

text.p: CME April hogs were down sharply in late trade as long liquidation and profit taking helped to trigger sell-stops, floor traders said.
They noted the failure of the cash pork product market to strengthen recently, contrary to many expectations, had helped to spark liquidation. Cash product values were reported to be mixed at midday.
Liquidation of long April/short June spreads was featured.
April dipped to a low of 69.150 cents a lb, off 1.225 cents. Other months were down 0.775 to 0.125 cent late.
